result.paraphrase: E-learning is a highly dynamic and continually expanding field that refers to educational content or learning experiences delivered through digital technologies. Advancing this area has a direct effect on education quality and cost reduction. E-learning is now largely dominated by learning management systems such as Moodle, and improving the interoperability of these systems is a key concern; the use of data and resources is a major requirement, pushing the e-learning community to look for new approaches to enhance system interoperability. Meanwhile, Semantic Web technologies provide standards such as RDF, which make it possible to describe Web resources along with their metadata. In this work, we propose an approach based on Semantic Web technology to improve the interoperability of e-Learning systems like Moodle.
